object: observability: no error tracking in production
evidence: no Sentry or equivalent in package.json or src/
why: Nothing was wired up and nothing has needed it while the only user is Don. The daily deploy-health check catches the one failure mode that mattered so far — the database being unreachable.
cost_if_forgotten: A runtime error for a real member is invisible. Nobody is paged, nothing is logged where anyone looks, and the first signal is a person giving up and not saying why. The DATABASE_URL outage went four months unnoticed for exactly this reason.
revisit_if: ANY of: a member outside the team signs up; a bug is reported that nobody can reproduce; or 2026-10-16 passes with this still open.
